title: Full PID Controller

hints.title: How to read the encoder position
hints.content: Use `int currentPosition = testMotor.getCurrentPosition();` to read the encoder. In this simulation, it returns 300.

hints.title: How to calculate error
hints.content: Error is `target - current`: `double error = targetPosition - currentPosition;` With target 1000 and current 300, error is 700.

hints.title: How to calculate the P term
hints.content: Multiply Kp by error: `double power = Kp * error;` With Kp = 0.001 and error = 700, the power is 0.7.

hints.title: What about the I and D terms?
hints.content: For this exercise, we only use the P term. In a real PID, you would add `+ Ki * integral + Kd * derivative`, but those require multiple loop iterations to be meaningful.
